Controllable.setController(address,bool): onlyOwner, timelocked controller whitelist update

XVault.mintAndRedeem(uint256): atomic mint then redeem path

ERC20._transfer(address,address,uint256): internal SafeMath guarded balance movement
XToken.setVaultAddress(address): onlyOwner reverse link registration

edges.reason: msg.sender selects the pendingWithdrawals slot read by withdraw
withdraw reads and zeroes pendingWithdrawals[msg.sender] before paying
withdraw executes msg.sender.transfer(amount) as its final effect
the ETH transfer hands control to the recipient which can re-enter withdraw
msg.sender is the buyer whose value and balance are handled in buyPunk
buyPunk loads the Offer from punksOfferedForSale
buyPunk overwrites punkIndexToAddress[punkIndex] with msg.sender
buyPunk decrements the seller balance and increments the buyer balance without SafeMath
buyPunk credits pendingWithdrawals[seller] with msg.value
buyPunk inspects punkBids to refund a matching bid
transferPunk requires msg.sender to be the current punk owner
transferPunk moves balanceOf between accounts with unchecked arithmetic
transferPunk refunds the new owner's own bid into pendingWithdrawals
enterBidForPunk records msg.sender as the bidder with msg.value
enterBidForPunk refunds the superseded bidder via pendingWithdrawals
enterBidForPunk writes the new Bid into punkBids
acceptBidForPunk requires msg.sender to be the punk owner/seller
acceptBidForPunk applies unchecked balanceOf decrement and increment
acceptBidForPunk clears the consumed bid
acceptBidForPunk credits the seller with the bid value in pendingWithdrawals
withdrawBidForPunk requires punkBids[punkIndex].bidder to equal msg.sender
withdrawBidForPunk deletes the bid before refunding
withdrawBidForPunk sends ETH to msg.sender via transfer
the ETH refund can re-enter withdrawBidForPunk from the recipient
setInitialOwner has its onlyOwner check commented out, so any caller can assign punks
setInitialOwner is only weakly gated by the allPunksAssigned flag
setInitialOwner increments and decrements balanceOf with raw arithmetic
setInitialOwner decrements punksRemainingToAssign without underflow protection
getPunk assigns the punk to msg.sender for free
getPunk writes punkIndexToAddress[punkIndex] = msg.sender
getPunk decrements punksRemainingToAssign with unchecked arithmetic
punkNoLongerForSale requires msg.sender to own the punk
punkNoLongerForSale resets the Offer entry to a non-sale state
sendValue forwards value to an arbitrary caller-supplied recipient
sendValue performs recipient.call{value: amount}("") with all gas forwarded
the callee fallback executes before sendValue finalizes, enabling reentrancy
_functionCallWithValue executes target.call{value: weiValue}(data)
an arbitrary target contract regains control inside the low-level call
mintPunk computes and charges the fee against msg.sender
mintPunk delegates the actual minting work to _mintPunk
_mintPunk verifies ownership through getCPM().punkIndexToAddress
_mintPunk adds the acquired tokenId to reserves
_mintPunk calls getERC20().mint to issue PUNK tokens to the depositor
redeemPunk charges the burn fee to msg.sender
redeemPunk delegates to _redeemPunk
_redeemPunk selects and removes a tokenId from reserves
_redeemPunk obtains the pick index from getPseudoRand
getPseudoRand mixes block.timestamp (now) into the random seed, a miner-influenceable value
getPseudoRand increments randNonce to vary the seed
the seed keccak256(abi.encodePacked(now, msg.sender, randNonce)) is predictable and miner manipulable
_redeemPunk makes an external CPM transferPunk call to deliver the punk
the external CPM call can re-enter the vault redemption path
_redeemPunk burns the user's ERC20 tokens through getERC20().burnFrom
Profitable.withdraw is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier to msg.sender
withdraw forwards the entire contract balance to an owner-supplied address
the balance transfer hands control to the recipient before the call returns
onlyOwner compares _owner against _msgSender for withdraw authorization
simpleRedeem burns ERC20 from msg.sender in exchange for a reserve punk
simpleRedeem removes the first reserve tokenId
simpleRedeem calls the external CPM transferPunk to hand over the punk
the external CPM call is a reentrancy ingress into simpleRedeem
directRedeem is gated by the onlyController modifier on _msgSender
directRedeem checks containment and removes the tokenId from reserves
directRedeem performs an external getCPM().transferPunk to the target address
onlyController consults verifiedControllers to authorize the caller
transferOwnership is onlyOwner, controlled by the current owner identity
transferOwnership overwrites the privileged _owner state variable
Manageable.migrate is onlyOwner and timelocked
migrate is gated by releaseTimes through the whenNotLockedL modifier
migrate availability depends on block.timestamp exceeding the release time
setIntegrator is onlyOwner and timelocked
setIntegrator flips the verifiedIntegrators whitelist entry
setIntegrator adjusts numIntegrators with SafeMath add/sub
setController is onlyOwner and timelocked
setController flips the verifiedControllers whitelist entry
redeemRetroactively is only callable once block.timestamp passes the short release time
redeemRetroactively picks and removes a tokenId from reserves
redeemRetroactively calls the external CPM transferPunk
mintAndRedeem is invoked by msg.sender and charges its fee
mintAndRedeem calls _mintPunk with partOfDualOp enabled
mintAndRedeem calls _redeemPunk with partOfDualOp enabled
_transfer mutates _balances using SafeMath sub and add
_transfer originates from _msgSender as the debited account
simpleRedeem is guarded by whenPaused reading the paused/inSafeMode state
turnOffSafeMode is onlyOwner, disabling a protective guard
turnOffSafeMode writes inSafeMode to false, weakening structural protections
setVaultAddress is onlyOwner
pause is onlyOwner
initiateUnlock computes the release time from now (block.timestamp)
whenNotLockedL reads releaseTimes[Timelock.Long] to authorize migrate
initiateUnlock stores newReleaseTime into releaseTimes
withdraw interacts with the fee configuration state used to fund the contract
mintPunk reads the mintFees table to size the required payment
simpleRedeem resolves the ERC20 implementation through erc20Address
_redeemPunk resolves the punk market through cpmAddress

normalization_plan.reason: The punkIndex parameter only exists inside setInitialOwner and should be folded into that function node.
The to parameter is a pure argument of setInitialOwner and carries no independent semantics.
amount is only consumed by Address.sendValue and should merge into it.
recipient is the external call target of sendValue and belongs to that function node.
target is the callee of the low-level call inside _functionCallWithValue.
data is the calldata blob forwarded by the low-level call.
weiValue is the value attached to the low-level call op_target_call_value.
newOwner is only meaningful as the argument of Ownable.transferOwnership.
The amount local is a temporary read of pendingWithdrawals inside withdraw.
fee is a transient computation inside mintPunk and has no separate identity.
randomIndex exists only inside _redeemPunk and feeds the reserve selection.
tokenId is a temporary picked from reserves inside simpleRedeem.
newReleaseTime is computed and stored solely inside Timelocked.initiateUnlock.
balance is a transient read of address(this).balance inside Profitable.withdraw.
The to parameter is only used as the transfer destination within directRedeem.
